answers.core: I think this is the way users expect the RichTextLabel to handle images.
answers.workaround:
The problem can be reduced by changing the font top and bottom extra_spacing. But this may not work if there are images of different sizes.
![example_extra_spacing](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/33575693/76662586-afec3900-657e-11ea-97d2-2d7d336941a6.png)
Edit: This only works in the editor and doesn't work at runtime so it doesn't solve the problem.

title: Add vertical alignment for [img] in RichTextLabel
